subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which remaining browser field-report items should become first-class browser API behavior now, rather than staying as skill/docs guidance or separate future research?
rationale: The low-risk selector and batch ergonomics are already implemented, but stale-state, CAPTCHA, readiness, inspection, post-action diff, and form-verification signals affect the model-facing browser contract and need an owner-approved API shape.

options.title: Prioritize browser-state signals
options.body: Create focused follow-ups for refsStale, captchaDetected, readiness, and post-action refresh/diff semantics, each with live browser proof before merge.

options.title: Keep guidance-only for now
options.body: Limit the remaining behavior to browser automation skill/docs guidance and close only narrower reproducible bugs as they appear.

options.title: Sponsor a broader browser API design
options.body: Design a coordinated action/result API covering inspection, diffs, recovery signals, and form verification before implementation begins.

recommendation.title: Prioritize browser-state signals
recommendation.body: Create focused follow-ups for refsStale, captchaDetected, readiness, and post-action refresh/diff semantics, each with live browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the merged partial implementation and have the strongest recent history on the browser action contract surface.
